message.content:
Let  
\[
S=\sum_{k=1}^{35}\sin(5k)^\circ.
\]
Set \(\theta=5^\circ\). Using
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{n}\sin(k\theta)=\frac{\sin\left(\frac{n\theta}{2}\right)\sin\left(\frac{(n+1)\theta}{2}\right)}{\sin\left(\frac{\theta}{2}\right)},
\]
with \(n=35\), we get
\[
S=\frac{\sin(87.5^\circ)\sin(90^\circ)}{\sin(2.5^\circ)}
=\frac{\sin(87.5^\circ)}{\sin(2.5^\circ)}.
\]
Since \(\sin(87.5^\circ)=\cos(2.5^\circ)\),
\[
S=\frac{\cos(2.5^\circ)}{\sin(2.5^\circ)}=\cot(2.5^\circ).
\]
Thus
\[
\tan(r^\circ)=\cot(2.5^\circ)=\tan(87.5^\circ).
\]
So
\[
r=87.5+180n
\]
for an integer \(n\). The smallest positive rational value is
\[
r=87.5=\frac{175}{2}.
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{\frac{175}{2}}\).
